content: 1. No dose adjustment is required for rilpivirine when co-administered with itraconazole. However, both drugs can prolong the QTc interval, so caution and monitoring are advised. 2. Ketoconazole increases rilpivirine levels by inhibiting CYP3A4 metabolism in the liver and intestines. Use caution and monitor patients closely. No rilpivirine dose adjustment is necessary. 3. When azole antifungals are co-administered with rilpivirine, monitor for breakthrough fungal infections. 4. Rilpivirine increases the toxicity of lapatinib by prolonging the QTc interval. Use caution and monitor patients closely. 5. Rilpivirine should be used cautiously with drugs that have a known risk of Torsades de Pointes, as it can increase the risk of QTc prolongation. 6. Levofloxacin and rilpivirine both prolong the QTc interval, increasing the risk of toxicity. Use caution and monitor patients closely. 7. Levoketoconazole increases rilpivirine levels by inhibiting CYP3A4 metabolism. Use caution and monitor patients closely. No rilpivirine dose adjustment is required. 8. Magnesium chloride decreases rilpivirine levels by increasing gastric pH. This interaction applies only to the oral forms of both agents. Therapy should be modified, and close monitoring is required. If antacids are necessary, administer them at least 2 hours before or 4 hours after rilpivirine. 9. Co-administration of antacids with rilpivirine can significantly reduce rilpivirine plasma concentrations due to increased gastric pH. Administer antacids at least 2 hours before or 4 hours after rilpivirine. 10. Magnesium gluconate decreases rilpivirine levels by increasing gastric pH. This interaction applies only to the oral forms of both agents. Therapy should be modified, and close monitoring is required. 11. Magnesium oxide decreases rilpivirine levels by increasing gastric pH. This interaction applies only to the oral forms of both agents. Therapy should be modified, and close monitoring is required. 12. For the combination product dolutegravir/rilpivirine, antacids should be administered at least 4 hours before or 6 hours after the combination product. 13. Magnesium sulfate decreases rilpivirine levels by increasing gastric pH. This interaction applies only to the oral forms of both agents. Therapy should be modified, and close monitoring is required. 14. Rilpivirine increases the toxicity of maprotiline by prolonging the QTc interval. Use caution and monitor patients closely. 15. Mavorixafor increases rilpivirine levels by inhibiting CYP3A4 metabolism. Both drugs prolong the QTc interval. Therapy should be modified, and close monitoring is required. Monitor QTc during treatment, especially in patients with risk factors for QTc prolongation. 16. Rilpivirine increases the toxicity of mefloquine by prolonging the QTc interval. Use caution and monitor patients closely. 17. No dose adjustments are required when initiating co-administration of methadone with rilpivirine. However, rilpivirine increases the toxicity of methadone by prolonging the QTc interval. Use caution and monitor patients closely. 18. Mirtazapine and rilpivirine both prolong the QTc interval. Use caution and monitor patients closely. 19. Moxifloxacin increases the toxicity of rilpivirine by prolonging the QTc interval. Similarly, rilpivirine increases the toxicity of moxifloxacin. Use caution and monitor patients closely. 20. Nefazodone increases rilpivirine levels by inhibiting CYP3A4 metabolism. Use caution and monitor patients closely. 21. Nelfinavir increases rilpivirine levels by inhibiting CYP3A4 metabolism. Use caution and monitor patients closely. 22. Rilpivirine increases the toxicity of nilotinib by prolonging the QTc interval. Use caution and monitor patients closely. 23. Nizatidine decreases rilpivirine levels by increasing gastric pH. This interaction applies only to the oral forms of both agents. Therapy should be modified, and close monitoring is required. Administer H2 antagonists at least 12 hours before or 4 hours after rilpivirine. 24. Rilpivirine increases the toxicity of nortriptyline by prolonging the QTc interval. Use caution and monitor patients closely. 25. Rilpivirine increases the toxicity of octreotide by prolonging the QTc interval. Use caution and monitor patients closely. 26. Rilpivirine increases the toxicity of ofloxacin by prolonging the QTc interval. Use caution and monitor patients closely. 27. Olanzapine and rilpivirine both prolong the QTc interval. Use caution and monitor patients closely. 28. Orlistat decreases rilpivirine levels by inhibiting gastrointestinal absorption. This interaction applies only to the oral forms of both agents. Use caution and monitor patients closely. Loss of virological control has been reported in HIV-infected patients taking orlistat concomitantly. Monitor HIV RNA levels frequently, and discontinue orlistat if increased viral load is confirmed. 29. Osilodrostat and rilpivirine both prolong the QTc interval. Use caution and monitor patients closely. 30. Ozanimod and rilpivirine both prolong the QTc interval. Therapy should be modified, and close monitoring is required. Treatment with ozanimod should generally not be initiated in patients concurrently treated with QT-prolonging drugs with known arrhythmogenic properties. 31. Rilpivirine increases the toxicity of paliperidone by prolonging the QTc interval. Use caution and monitor patients closely. 32. Rilpivirine increases the toxicity of pazopanib by prolonging the QTc interval. Use caution and monitor patients closely. 33. Rilpivirine increases the toxicity of pentamidine by prolonging the QTc interval. Use caution and monitor patients closely. 34. Rilpivirine increases the toxicity of pimozide by prolonging the QTc interval. Use caution and monitor patients closely. 35. Posaconazole increases rilpivirine levels by inhibiting CYP3A4 metabolism. Use caution and monitor patients closely. No rilpivirine dose adjustment is required. Rilpivirine also increases the toxicity of posaconazole by prolonging the QTc interval. 36. Potassium chloride decreases rilpivirine levels by increasing gastric pH. This interaction applies only to the oral forms of both agents. Therapy should be modified, and close monitoring is required. 37. Primaquine and rilpivirine both prolong the QTc interval. Use caution and monitor patients closely. 38. Rilpivirine increases the toxicity of procainamide by prolonging the QTc interval. Use caution and monitor patients closely. 39. Rilpivirine increases the toxicity of propafenone by prolonging the QTc interval. Use caution and monitor patients closely. 40. Rilpivirine increases the toxicity of protriptyline by prolonging the QTc interval. Use caution and monitor patients closely. 41. Rilpivirine increases the toxicity of quetiapine by prolonging the QTc interval. Use caution and monitor patients closely. 42. Rilpivirine increases the toxicity of quinidine by prolonging the QTc interval. Use caution and monitor patients closely. 43. Rilpivirine increases the toxicity of quinine by prolonging the QTc interval. Use caution and monitor patients closely. 44. Quizartinib and rilpivirine both prolong the QTc interval. Therapy should be modified, and close monitoring is required. Monitor patients more frequently with ECG if co-administered with QT-prolonging drugs. 45. Rilpivirine increases the toxicity of ranolazine by prolonging the QTc interval. Use caution and monitor patients closely. 46. Rilpivirine increases the toxicity of risperidone by prolonging the QTc interval. Use caution and monitor patients closely. 47. Ritonavir increases rilpivirine levels by inhibiting CYP3A4 metabolism. Use caution and monitor patients closely. Rilpivirine also increases the toxicity of ritonavir by prolonging the QTc interval. 48. Rilpivirine increases the toxicity of romidepsin by prolonging the QTc interval. Use caution and monitor patients closely. 49. Selpercatinib increases the toxicity of rilpivirine by prolonging the QTc interval. Use caution and monitor patients closely. 50. Sertraline and rilpivirine both prolong the QTc interval. Use caution and monitor patients closely. 51. Sodium zirconium cyclosilicate decreases rilpivirine levels by increasing gastric pH. This interaction applies only to the oral forms of both agents. Therapy should be modified, and close monitoring is required. Administer drugs at least 2 hours before or after sodium zirconium cyclosilicate. 52. Solifenacin and rilpivirine both prolong the QTc interval. Use caution and monitor patients closely. 53. Rilpivirine increases the toxicity of sotalol by prolonging the QTc interval. Use caution and monitor patients closely. 54. Rilpivirine increases the toxicity of sunitinib by prolonging the QTc interval. Use caution and monitor patients closely. 55. Rilpivirine increases the toxicity of tacrolimus by prolonging the QTc interval. Use caution and monitor patients closely. 56. Rilpivirine increases the toxicity of telavancin by prolonging the QTc interval. Use caution and monitor patients closely. 57. Rilpivirine increases the toxicity of thioridazine by prolonging the QTc interval. Use caution and monitor patients closely. 58. Rilpivirine increases the toxicity of thiothixene by prolonging the QTc interval. Use caution and monitor patients closely. 59. Tipranavir increases rilpivirine levels by inhibiting CYP3A4 metabolism. Use caution and monitor patients closely. Rilpivirine is not expected to affect the plasma concentrations of co-administered protease inhibitors. 60. Rilpivirine increases the toxicity of toremifene by prolonging the QTc interval. Use caution and monitor patients closely. 61. Trimagnesium citrate anhydrous decreases rilpivirine levels by increasing gastric pH. This interaction applies only to the oral forms of both agents. Therapy should be modified, and close monitoring is required. 62. Rilpivirine increases the toxicity of trimipramine by prolonging the QTc interval. Use caution and monitor patients closely. 63. Ublituximab decreases the effects of rilpivirine due to immunosuppressive effects, increasing the risk of infection. Therapy should be modified, and close monitoring is required. 64. Valbenazine and rilpivirine both prolong the QTc interval. Use caution and monitor patients closely. 65. Rilpivirine increases the toxicity of vandetanib by prolonging the QTc interval. Use caution and monitor patients closely. 66. Voclosporin and rilpivirine both prolong the QTc interval. Use caution and monitor patients closely. 67. Voriconazole increases rilpivirine levels by inhibiting CYP3A4 metabolism. Use caution and monitor patients closely.
